# Feature map

What this project can do today, what it cannot, and where the evidence lives.
**This file is generated by hand but checked by machine**: every row must name an
artifact that exists (`scripts/check-features.mjs` runs in `npm run verify` and
in CI), so a row cannot claim a capability whose code has been deleted, and a
package cannot disappear without a row going red.

Vocabulary — the same five classes as the fidelity contract (§0 of
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`):

| class | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `exact` | observable behaviour is the same, bytes included |
| `equivalent` | same effect, different bytes or a different mechanism |
| `derived` | our decision; the foreign ecosystem has no such surface |
| `planned` | carried (parsed, annotated, reported) but not active |
| `unsupported` | refused with a reason; will not be served without a new decision |

Pins: DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` / `0.2.2-rc.2`, claude-code `2.1.329` (`f9e4d1e`),
codex plugin spec `1.0.0`.

## 1. Capability snapshot

The one number the project reports: **32 declared / 31 matched / 0 missing /
1 refused** across the coverage ratchet's 13 coverage rows
(`packages/dsh-anyplugin-conformance/test/coverage.test.mjs`). It only moves
when a row moves; see `docs/TODO.md` for the queue behind it.

## 5. Repository guard (call-time policy, not a seam)

| surface | what it does today | class | artifact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PreToolUse guard | tool layer sees a tool call: judges a push by shape (`git push [-u or --force-with-lease] origin <one non-main refspec>`; bare, extra/wildcard/range refspecs, other remotes, `--receive-pack`/`--exec`, `send-pack` and `update-ref` refused), every-role modelled `gh pr merge` that performs a merge pinned to a full `--match-head-commit` sha (a worker still may not merge; a value flag cannot swallow the pin, and a `gh api` path for the merge route is refused whatever the method), a closed inert config allowlist for both roles (workers read config, the root writes only inert keys), `.git` writes refused through shell, structured and interpreter mutation verbs and `tar -C`/`-Cdir`, `sudo` refused for workers at command position after the modelled launchers, literal interpreter spawn tokens (`exec`, `popen`, `spawn`) refused with quoted literals masked, `git-env-prefix` for any leading assignment on a worker git segment, unknown git subcommands for workers, writes outside the recorded worktree (no fail-open), unverified **shell** script files and `docs/DECISIONS.md` edits; each denial also appends a redacted JSON line to the gitignored `.audit/guard-denials.jsonl` (best-effort, deduped per session and call id, aggregated by `audit:evidence`); one `cordis.patch.yml` insert whose uninstall restores prior bytes, a linked-worktree install refused before the shared hooks are touched, plus a `pre-push` hook as defence in depth (skipped by `--no-verify`) | `derived` | `packages/dsh-anyplugin-guard/src/index.ts`, `packages/dsh-anyplugin-guard/src/denials.ts`, `scripts/guard-install.mjs`, `scripts/guard-status.mjs` |
| SubagentStart brief | appends the worktree path, ratchet totals, open rows and the shell subset once, as a host-shaped user message (`id` + `source.kind: 'user'`), to a worker's first `agent/pre-step` continuation | `derived` | `packages/dsh-anyplugin-guard/src/brief.ts` |

## 7. What is deliberately not a feature — and the partial theme seam

- **Terminal themes (F2) — a partial seam, `planned`, not a feature yet.**
  A plugin can register a theme through `ctx.theme`
  (`ThemeRuntime.register`), and `ThemeTokens` is `Record<string, string>`:
  the inspector's 14 curated `--dsw-*` tokens are not a registration limit.
  Two of Claude's 72 roles have a real destination: `text` →
  `--dsw-alias-label-primary` and `background` → `--dsw-alias-bg-base`;
  `theme-presenter.ts` writes active tokens to `document.body`,
  `terminal.module.css` consumes those two, and `terminal.tsx:142` passes the
  computed foreground/background to xterm. The other 70 roles have no DSH
  terminal counterpart, `ansi:<name>`/`ansi256(n)` values have no host palette,
  and the ANSI 16 are written only from OSC 4/104:
  `terminal-theme.ts:57-64` has `update(background, foreground)` and no palette
  argument, and `:72-79` writes ANSI only from `this.indexed`. `themes/` is
  therefore one `planned` row (`readOptionalSurfaces`, D74): the host gap is
  the ANSI-16 palette, not the plugin theme API. No fixture or materializer
  exists.
- **GUI chrome (F3).** The foreign side has no such artifact, so it is `derived`
  and excluded from the denominator.
- **Model identity in `agents/*.md`** (`model: sonnet`). The host has no
  alias-to-provider-model mapping (S16), so this layer declares one: the
  overridable model map (D91) resolves a mapped alias to a provider route and
  the face is `derived` — this layer's policy, not Claude semantics. The
  materializer forwards only an id and effort the session catalog advertises;
  an alias the map does not declare stays `unsupported`; delegating to the real
  client is the only path to true Claude model identity.
- **Mod `$.ui.ask`.** No host interaction to ask into; absent member by design.
